notes.title: Here Comes a New Gameplay Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve been inactive and we’ve missed you a lot! We have no opportunity to make new characters but we’re back with a new important  gameplay update!  We also put the demo of the game as free steam game so it will gain a bit more visibility.

The update includes:
- Bug fixes
- New visual effects (shadow while jumping, blocking hit vfx...)
- Various hits tweaking
- Finetuning of the gameplay (dodge, hits freezetime, screnshakes...)

It's still a pre-alpha version of the game but we hope you'll enjoy it, tell us what you think about it! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31952293/cd76cdd2bfb056e0ed36d81d9d42fa9ae11ae8d4.png
